# Joint practice forms further participation and continuation

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

The practice machine is a partial law: its traces are exactly its completed runs. Instances of the gated-change law: only revision changes the recorded methods and only an organizational adoption changes the rule, so every course without them keeps both. A practice round, for every state: the round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry by a reviewer and a worker completes exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; it then records the review, installs the context’s method in the worker, completes the trial and changes nothing else. So the worker is then trained, a trained reviewer needs no further check, and training is kept along every course without revision that returns to the context. The three rounds of the complete history are instances; the step definitions are the machine’s own, and the enrollments and handoff between the rounds are checked on that history. Within the declared two-method task, actual attempts and responses form a revised procedure. A successful retry produces the review relation consumed by the existing admission process; admitted participation enables later response and formation of further participation after the initial reviewer leaves.

Canonical source: [JointPracticeContinuation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/JointPracticeContinuation.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The two-method task, current test relation, inference operation, correct seed configuration and one mandate are supplied.
- Records, communication, execution, available participants, event order, compliance and fixed higher authorization are supplied; handoff does not automatically delete recorded offices.

Attempt, response, revision, testing and recognition differentiate within one state history. Configuration is a local executable procedure, not a full model of human understanding. Primary group-learning and turnover studies provide bounded empirical motivation, not reproduction of this exact history. Revision reads the earlier actual result together with the response, retaining or changing the procedure after comparison; equivalence within the two-method family is checked.

## Validation and boundaries

Closes one enacted-practice-to-further-participation connection, not arrival of people, general cognition, formation of tasks/test relations, indefinite self-maintenance or comparative superiority.

- Missing response or revision, early departure, changed context and untested admission fail; local operation can succeed while higher admission conditions fail.
